tokens.name: ph-bg
tokens.usage: App background (deep phosphor-black / bone paper). Ground for `fg`, `fg-strong`, `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: ph-bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells below the app ground: code blocks, terminal output, inset sidebars.

tokens.name: ph-surface
tokens.usage: The muted surface: sidebar, inspector, Questions block, cards (shadcn `card`, HeroUI `surface`). Ground for every text token.

tokens.name: ph-surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised fill: the prompt/input block, active tab, hovered rows, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ph-surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected neutral fill, segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: ph-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers: popover, menu, tooltip, dialog. One step above `surface`.

tokens.name: ph-field
tokens.usage: Input, textarea and select background (the raised green of the prompt block).

tokens.name: ph-border
tokens.usage: Hairline: card edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative only (below 3:1 by design).

tokens.name: ph-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundary: input, checkbox and select outlines; 3:1 on `field`, `surface`, `bg`.

tokens.name: ph-fg
tokens.usage: Body text: golden khaki (dark) / olive ink (light) on every ground, including the muted `surface`.

tokens.name: ph-fg-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, active labels, values on every ground.

tokens.name: ph-fg-sage
tokens.usage: Secondary text role: sage (dark) / forest ink (light). Inactive tabs, neutral values, table body in dense data.

tokens.name: ph-fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders: 4.5:1 on every ground up to `surface-2`.

tokens.name: ph-fg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (WCAG-exempt).

tokens.name: ph-primary
tokens.usage: Mint / deep jade: the one saturated color; the brand signal. Primary buttons, active nav, toggles on, progress. As text it holds 4.5:1 on `bg`/`surface`.
